info.name: Daisy AI Analysis API
info.description:
Complete API collection for DAISY AI Tool - Healthcare Questionnaire Analysis System

This collection includes all endpoints for:
- PDF questionnaire analysis
- Result retrieval by professional ID
- Result retrieval by professional and patient ID
- Manual result saving
- Database health monitoring

item.name: Analysis

formdata.description: PDF file containing healthcare questionnaire data

request.description:
Upload and analyze a PDF questionnaire file using OpenAI.

**Request:**
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: multipart/form-data
- Body: PDF file (key: "file")

**Response:**
- Returns complete Prompt1Result with A1-A6 and B1-B3 modules
- Includes professional name, client name, and teleonic analysis

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header

response.name: Successful Analysis

request.description:
Manually save a Prompt1Result to the database.

**Request:**
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: application/json
- Body: Complete Prompt1Result JSON object

**Response:**
- 200 OK on success

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header

request.description:
Retrieve all analysis results for a specific healthcare professional.

**Request:**
- Method: GET
- Path Parameter: professionalId (string)

**Response:**
- 200 OK: Array of Prompt1ResultEntity objects
- 404 Not Found: No results for this professional

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header

response.name: Results Found

item.name: Get Results by Professional and Patient ID

request.description:
Retrieve analysis results for a specific professional-patient combination.

**Request:**
- Method: GET
- Path Parameters:
  - professionalId (string)
  - patientId (string)

**Response:**
- 200 OK: Array of matching Prompt1ResultEntity objects
- Empty array if no matches found

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header

response.name: Specific Patient Results

item.description: Endpoints for retrieving stored analysis results

request.description:
Check the health status of connected databases.

**Request:**
- Method: GET
- No parameters required

**Response:**
- 200 OK: Database is healthy
- 503 Service Unavailable: Database issues detected
- 500 Internal Server Error: Health check failed

**Response Format:**
- Plain text message with primary and secondary database status

**Authentication:**
- Requires X-API-KEY header
